verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway lets agents connect to gateway-hosted MCP endpoints: the AI MCP Server entity turns any API into an MCP server, and AI MCP Proxy can front upstream MCP servers, with auth strategies attachable to those servers. However, these are MCP servers built from the user's own APIs, and the evidence shows no official first-party MCP server for operating the gateway or Konnect itself. missing for 10: an official MCP server exposing Kong AI Gateway/Konnect management to agents, setup docs for connecting an agent client, independent or hands-on corroboration.
